description: Activate or resume recurring weekly or monthly tool calls. maxCostMicroPerRun must equal the tracker estimate being accepted; activation authorizes future billed calls until the tracker is paused. The response carries a billing block with the balance, the cost per run, and runsDryAt — the date the balance stops covering the account's active trackers — so relay it. When tracker emails are enabled, activation sends a setup summary and every completed run sends current results and suggested next steps, even when nothing changed. Activation is refused when the balance cannot cover even the next run; tell the user to top up at cite42.dev/app/billing. Tracker management and stored-report reads are free. Each scheduled or manual run bills one call per prompt at the normal per-model rates; the activation response and tracker record expose the accepted maximum cost per run. Present the returned USD amounts to users; activation still takes the exact estimatedCostMicroPerRun integer returned by the tracker.

maxCostMicroPerRun.description: Exact estimatedCostMicroPerRun returned by the latest tracker record.

trackerId.description: Cite42 tracker ID returned by a tracker management or report tool.
